mira: Opening a tiny PR with a local repro + checklist for 429s/timeouts when context limits are hit. Will include python sdk + curl examples.

sam: Nice. Please include concrete backoff numbers ops can use.

mira: plan: exponential backoff start=200ms, max=5s, jittered. Add how to tell context-eviction vs rate-limit (headers + body).

doc-bot: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822 (tags: err-ref, 429, timeout).

jordan: Add a short note on Dedicated vs Hosted concurrency differences — folks conflate per-connection vs account windows.

mira: will add one-liner table + link to runtime capacity guide.

len: nit: don't show infinite retries in python snippet. Recommend max_attempts=3.

mira: updated. Snippet (pseudocode):
```
# python retry pseudocode
max_attempts=3
backoff=0.2
for i in range(max_attempts):
  resp = client.generate(prompt)
  if resp.status==200: break
  if resp.status==429:
    prompt = trim_history(prompt, keep_tokens=1024)
    sleep(backoff*(2**i))
  else:
    raise
```

sam: good. Add curl example showing Retry-After header check.

mira: added curl example and quick note to look for `HTTP/1.1 429` and `Retry-After`.
